points.description: States that the reservoir area curve is a plot (graph/curve) of water spread area (water surface area) of the reservoir against reservoir elevation, with both variables named correctly: water spread area and elevation.
points.partial_credit: Half credit (0.75) only if it is clearly a plot/graph of area against elevation but one variable is vague (e.g. just 'area' without 'water spread' or 'surface') .

points.description: Correct relationship stated: area vs elevation (area as function of reservoir elevation/water level), identifying it as a plot/curve and not a table, volume or other quantity.

rubric.notes: Full marks need a plot or curve of water spread area against reservoir elevation, with both terms named. Give part marks only if the idea is clearly a plot of area versus elevation but a term is vague, such as 'area' alone. Any wrong variable, such as volume or capacity or discharge, or an answer with no plot or relationship, earns 0 for that point.
